activity.role: Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the USSR
activity.notes: Aleksei Nikolayevich Kosygin (Алексей Николаевич Косыгин; 1904-02-21 to 1980-12-18) served as Chairman of the USSR Council of Ministers from 15 October 1964 to 23 October 1980. This is formal head-of-government authority in the Soviet Union, not a claim to have held the CPSU General Secretaryship or to have been the USSR's sole paramount ruler. His 1965 economic-reform program and his mediation at the January 1966 Tashkent talks are historical context, not separately dated offices in this request. His RSFSR Council of People's Commissars chairmanship from 23 June 1943 to 23 March 1946 concerns a different political level and is deliberately NOT conflated with the USSR premiership.
